correctness.rationale: All six ordinal intervals are explicitly resolved and the doubling map sends each bijectively onto a union of full cells; Lebesgue-conditioned cylinders therefore give an exact Markov transition matrix. The first-entrance PGF follows by summing initial self-loops, compulsory exit, complement excursions and return via a finite resolvent. Exact elimination and derivatives at one give the three rational laws and mean/variance table. The checker reconstructs the cells and independently integrates 60 first-entrance interval probabilities for n<=10 with exact fractions, checking moments and intensities; finite tests are not claimed to prove infinite lengths.

value.rationale: This is the complete first nontrivial six-permutation ordinal-section entrance-time classification of the basic exact expanding interval map. It identifies all probabilities and demonstrates a nonobvious overdispersion/underdispersion split: one rare pair has variance 188 exceeding its geometric comparator 132, while the other four are below theirs. Such fully calibrated entrance statistics provide a natural reference for ordinal Poincaré recurrence studies; narrow map and window scope is explicit.
